newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: MCI says in Lisbon no word on Telefonica today.
newsitem.headline: MCI says in Lisbon no word on Telefonica today.

text.p: A spokesman for MCI said in Lisbon that a reference in a Portugal Telecom statement to the U.S. company's having announced a joint venture with Telefonica Internacional, an international arm of Spain's Telefonica, was "an error".

"It was an error contained in the press release," MCI Director Michael Rowny told a news conference. But he refused to answer when asked whether a deal had been struck between the companies. He said that no statement would be made by Telefonica or MCI today about any possible joint venture.
Portugal Telecom was announcing that it had chosen the British Telecom -MCI joint venture Concert as its global ally.

The English version of the statement FROM Telecom said that this alliance would work together in Latin America through the "Pan American joint venture announced today by MCI and Telefonica Internacional."
The chief exective of British Telecom Peter Bonfield said that Telefonica had been talking to a number of potential partners in its search for a U.S. alliance.
"We are going to have to wait a little bit more," he said.
